body.statement: Conditional on \((M,\Omega)\), fixed \(q\), uniform sub-Gaussian moments, row-law factorization, conditional within-row block dependence, frontier variance nondegeneracy, and frontier score diffuseness imply \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_n(a,b,c)}\sup_{z\in\mathbb R}|\mathbb P_P(L/s\le z\mid M,\Omega)-\Phi(z)|\to0\) uniformly when \((a,b,c)\) ranges over a compact subset of \([1/2,1]\times(0,1]\times[0,1]\).
body.justification: A dependency-graph Lyapunov argument remains valid uniformly as the cohort and window exponents vary because the frontier weights are diffuse at their rescaled standard error.
body.gap: Available serial factor central limit theorems do not provide this compact-uniform exponent-indexed statement for deterministic causal-block masking.
body.consumer: The sharp-frontier achievability direction can focus on native-optimizer remainders rather than postulating a Gaussian leading score.
